data.desc: Innovative Eyewear is a developer and manufacturer of cutting-edge ChatGPT-enabled smart eyewear, under the Lucyd, Lucyd Armor, Reebok, Nautica and Eddie Bauer brands. True to our mission to Upgrade Your Eyewear, our Bluetooth audio glasses allow users to stay safely and ergonomically connected to their digital lives and are offered in hundreds of frame and lens combinations to meet the needs of the optical, sunglass, sporting goods and safety eyewear markets. To learn more and explore our continuously evolving collection of smart eyewear, please visit www.lucyd.co.
